Research, Education in your unique metabolic functioning/malfunctioning and discipline in your glucosal regulation 
Like fingerprint/retina 
Everyone is uniquely different 
What works for Jan, not necessarily as effective for Jean, but won't do diddly squat for Joan 
Being diligent and ask questions, research for answers. Ppl will experience trial/error in a reboot of their metabolism reset but, achievable none the less .
I've learned how thru exchange of MY own experiences and I've been able to educate my Healthcare team on different ways to approach others in diabetic treatment reform.
Medicine is definitely a practice  and patient, dr, etc if we're willing
We're able to teach,learn from one another 
Willingness to accept the exchanges of prospective ideas in onset in treatment  overtime, 
What works what's not so beneficial to the individual. My diabetic support team  has tentatively realized we're all an anomaly in some fashion or another when standardized treatment methods are implemented yet not as effective as thought 
Be willing to test the limits and find out what works FOR YOU
